title: Den vs Harrison/Quotes
summary:
"I am, how should I say, a talent scout for a special school."
- Tantras to orphans

"These boys called you names, picked on you. They hate you. Gather your anger, Harrison, your loneliness, your hate. Turn them against your enemies with Marauder."
- Tantras to Harrison Fears

"I've never felt like this. It's like I could destroy the world with my bare hands."
- Harrison Fears to Den Fears

"You were an embarrassment back there. Don't screw this up for me!"
- Harrison Fears to Den Fears

"Don't throw this away. It's about having a future, Den, getting out of that prison."
- Harrison Fears to Den Fears

"Hey, Cherit, whatever happened to your Amulet?" (Lok Lambert)
"It's been so long now, I can't even remember what it looks like." (Cherit)

"You put them on a dead end, not a path. You'll pay, Tantras!"
- Zhalia Moon to Tantras, talking about the three orphans Tantras recruited
